name: KGB
recent: Kelington Group Berhad 近期在砂拉越古晋连续获得三份合约，总额达 RM544 million，最新一份为 RM128 million 的数据存储厂房项目。公司同时公布 2026 财年第二季度业绩，营收与净利均实现环比和同比增长。此外，董事及高管在闭门期前后有例行持股申报及小额交易。
notable: Kelington 在两周内于古晋获得第三份合约，价值 RM128 million，涉及数据存储厂房项目，使古晋合约总额升至 RM544 million。
公司公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收与净利均较上一季度及去年同期增长。
公司宣布第二次中期股息，并公布相关的股权登记与派发安排。
risks: 董事及高管在闭门期前后有持股申报及小额买卖记录，包括一名高管在 8 月底出售部分股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 RM344.4 million，环比增长 27.4%，同比增长 22.1%；净利为 RM41.3 million，环比增长 36.0%，同比增长 25.7%；净利率为 12.0%，高于上一季度的 11.2%。

recent_en: Kelington Group Berhad recently secured three contracts in Kuching, Sarawak, totaling RM544 million, with the latest being a RM128 million data storage plant project. The company also reported 2Q 2026 results with both revenue and net profit growing quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year. Separately, directors and senior management made routine shareholding disclosures and small trades around the closed period.
notable_en: Kelington secured its third contract in Kuching in two weeks, worth RM128 million, for a data storage plant project, bringing total Kuching contract value to RM544 million.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with both revenue and net profit rising versus the preceding quarter and the prior year.
The company declared a second interim dividend and announced the related book closure and payment arrangements.
risks_en: Directors and senior management made shareholding disclosures and small trades around the closed period, including one senior executive disposing of some shares in late August.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM344.4 million, up 27.4% qoq and 22.1% yoy; net profit was RM41.3 million, up 36.0% qoq and 25.7% yoy; net margin was 12.0%, higher than 11.2% in the preceding quarter.
